evidence_items.locator: Abstract, Results and Conclusions; Results, General trends
evidence_items.explanation: The audit documents all three failure types across popular chatbots, including fabricated citations and certainty accompanying incorrect answers. Professional-consultation disclaimers nevertheless appeared frequently, qualifying any literal claim of universal certainty.

evidence_items.locator: Section 5, Model performance dependency on treatment outcome effect
evidence_items.explanation: The publicly released 24-model evaluation independently reports reluctance to express uncertainty when synthesizing medical evidence. The date identifies the report's release; exact model-query dates were not established, so it is corroborating context rather than decisive dated outcome evidence.

unresolved_gaps: The studies do not measure the prevalence of these failures across all ordinary LLM use.
The cited evaluations measure information quality and potential risk, not resulting patient injuries.
